'My father kept it before me. Tell him I made it home.' The note was signed Margaret and dated forty years earlier. Elias knew the name. He folded the page, carried it up the stairs, and set it on the sill where the light would find it.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市终于安静下来。路灯把空荡的街道照成一条条昏黄的河，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，轮胎碾过积水，声音很快被夜色吞没。便利店的灯还亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处工地的塔吊静静伫立，像睡着的巨人。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。东边的天空泛起一点灰白，早点铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕热气，城市在不知不觉中醒来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by doing a smaller version of the same problem.\n- It's like opening a set of nesting dolls: you open one, find a smaller one inside, and keep going.\n- You stop when you reach the tiniest doll that doesn't open, and that's how the computer knows it's done."}
